missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Обед' is the nominative subject, described by the short adjective 'готов'. 'Почти' softens the claim. A clean model for a masculine noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Обед' is the accusative direct object of 'готовлю'. As an inanimate masculine noun, its accusative equals the nominative. 'Вкусный' is the agreeing adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Обеда' is the genitive required after 'после' to mean after lunch. 'Мы пойдём гулять' states the plan. A frequent time expression.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Обеду' is the dative form after 'рада', which governs the dative to show what one is glad about. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative. A useful emotion pattern.

Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Обедом' is the instrumental form required after 'довольны', which governs the instrumental. 'Вкусным' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A core satisfaction pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative in a time phrase. 'На обед' uses the accusative 'обед' after 'на' to mean for lunch. 'Суп' is the accusative object of 'ели'. A natural mealtime expression.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об обеде' uses the prepositional form 'обеде' after 'об' to express talking about lunch. 'Заранее' adds timing. A clean topic-of-conversation pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with location. 'Обед' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'. 'На столе' uses the prepositional to show where it stands, and 'кухонном' agrees with it. A simple everyday statement.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Обеда' takes the genitive singular after 'два'. 'Они приготовили' names who prepared them. A core counting pattern with food.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Обеды' is the accusative plural object of 'подают'. As an inanimate plural noun, its accusative equals the nominative. 'Горячие' is the agreeing plural adjective.
